summary: Advances wheel state history: copies the history header fields forward (current slots take the previous-slot values), rotates the per-wheel state history slots, and copies per-wheel delta buffers from the previous-state buffer into the current-state buffer. Then dispatches the suspension wheel dynamics solver, two batch iterators, a per-body update pass, and the physics sub-object free routine.

local_names.this: wheel/vehicle physics object: history header 0x1C5C/0x1C64 and 0x1E38/0x1E40, per-wheel history slots 0x340..0x354, state count 0x15AC, previous-state buffer pointer 0x15B0, current-state buffer pointer 0x162C
local_names.a2: time-step parameter forwarded to the dynamics solver and per-body update pass
local_names.v7: dword iterator over the 4 wheel history blocks (1124-byte stride)
local_names.v16: byte offset within the previous-state buffer entries (580-byte stride)
local_names.v17: byte offset within the current-state buffer entries (48-byte stride)

operations.description: Copy wheel-state history header forward: current slots this+0x1C64/0x1C68 take the previous values at this+0x1C5C/0x1C60, and current slots this+0x1E40/0x1E44 take the previous values at this+0x1E38/0x1E3C.

Per-wheel history slot rotation: 4 iterations over wheel blocks with a 1124-byte stride. Inside each block the dword pair at +0x340/+0x344 is copied from two dwords earlier, the pair at +0x350/+0x354 is copied from +0x348/+0x34C, and a 32-byte block is copied forward within the block.
If the wheel-state count at this+0x15AC is greater than zero, run the per-wheel delta-state buffer copy loop.

Per-wheel delta copy: for each wheel (count at this+0x15AC), copy 24 bytes from the previous-state buffer entry (this+0x15B0, 580-byte stride) at offsets +308 and +332 into the current-state buffer entry (this+0x162C, 48-byte stride).
SuspensionWheelDynamicsSolver(this, a2) runs the suspension wheel dynamics solve for the vehicle object.
sub_56ECF0(&this[0x15AC]) iterates the wheel-state region at this+0x15AC.
sub_56EE40(&this[0x15AC]) iterates the wheel-state region at this+0x15AC.
IteratePhysicsBodiesCallUpdateFunction(a2) runs the per-body update pass with the same time-step parameter.
Invoked from the frame-path integration step VehiclePhysicsIntegrationStep (00441650).
